question: Endoplasmic _______ (ER) is a large network of membrane-bound tubes and sheets.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reticulum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Endoplasmic Reticulum** is a network of **tubules or flattened sac** called vesicles that are **interconnected by a single continuous membrane**.
 
• **Functions** of **Endoplasmic Reticulum**
 
 
• Carries out **transport of materials** between different **parts of the cell**.
 
• Acts as **waste disposal **and **cell cleaning system**.
 
• **Breaks** down **worn-out** cellular **components**.
 
• It has **digestive enzymes** that break down **foreign material** from **entering the Cell**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Endoplasmic Reticulum** was **discovered **by** Albert Claude** and **Keith Porter** in **1945**.
 
• They are of two types
 
 
• **Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum(RER)** synthesizes and **secretes** serum **proteins, hormones, and other substances**.
 
• **Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER)** synthesizes **lipids and steroids**.
 
 
 
• **Ribosomes** are granular structures composed of** ribonucleic acid** and **proteins**.
 
 
• They **synthesize** **protein **in the cell and as a result, it is also known as the **Protein factory of the Cell**.
